text: I prayed with tears in my eyes, and God answered in ways I could never have imagined. His timing is always perfect. Hallelujah!

Heavenly Father,  
You know everything I am building, everything I hope to build and every place where I have been working with more confidence in myself than dependence on You. I surrender these things into Your hands because I want Jesus Christ to be the foundation beneath my decisions, my relationships, my work and every responsibility You have given me. Your word says in 1 Corinthians 3:11, for no can lay my foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.  
Father, establish this truth in me. Let Christ have the place that belongs to Him. Teach me to build my life around Him and remain close to Him when progress comes. Keep my heart from drifting into self-reliance when things begin to work well. Search what I am building right now, Lord, and look beyond what others can see into the deepest intentions of my heart. Purity every motive that has become divided. Humble every part of me that has been touched by pride and free me from the fear that quietly influences my decisions. Bring my heart back to simple trust in You. Especially when I feel uncertain about what lies ahead. When I become eager to move faster than Your timing, steady me and teach me to follow Your direction with patience, confidence and a heart that is willing to wait.  
Father, I place my plans before You and release every plan that has become more important to me than obedience. Give me the courage to change direction when Your word corrects me and give me peace when Your answer requires patience. I would rather move slowly with Your presence than move quickly into something You have not asked me to build.  
Father, let Your word become the standard for my choices. Jesus said that the wise person hears His words and puts them into practice. I receive that instruction today and I wan to obey they things I already know You have said. When Your word confronts my habits, let me respond. When it corrects my attitude, soften my heart. When it calls me to forgive, give me grace to forgive. When it calls me to integrity, let my private life agree what I confess publicly. Lord Jesus, be present in my home and in the relationships, You have entrusted to me. Teach me to build with patience, truth, faithfulness and love. Guard me from choices that create cracks through pride, careless words, hidden resentment, or selfish ambition. Give me wisdom to repair what has been damaged and humility to admit when I have been wrong. Let the people closest to me experience the fruit of a life that is truly submitted to You. I commit my work and responsibilities to You as well. Whatever You have placed in my hands, help me handle it faithfully. Give me clear judgement when decisions carry weight, discipline when the work becomes tiring and honesty when compromise seems easier. Keep success from becoming an idol in my heart. Let every achievement remain under Your authority and let every opportunity be tested by Your will rather than by how impressive it appears.   
Father, I bring my finances before You and ask for wisdom and contentment in the way I handle what You provide. Guard me from building my security around money, possessions, influence, or status. Give me a generous heart and a disciplines spirit. Help me make decisions that honour You and protect me from chasing gain at the cost of peace, integrity, family or obedience. I also surrender my future to You, including the things I want to see happen and the prayers I have carried for a long time. I place them before You without demanding that they happen according to my timetable. If the plan is from You, establish it. If it needs correction, redirect me and if it needs more time, strengthen me to wait. I trust Your wisdom more than my limited view. Lord, rebuild every area where I have laid the wrong foundation. Some choices may have been made without prayer. Some commitments may have grown from pressure, and some goals may have been driven by the desire to prove something. Bring Your order into those places and show me what should be strengthened and what I need to release completely. Give me the courage to obey whatever You reveal. Your word says in Psalm 127:1, “Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labour in vain.” I receive that warming with humility. I do not want to spend my strength on work that carries no approval from You. Build through me, Father, directing the labour of my hands so that my effort agrees with Your purpose. May the things that consume my time also have a place within Your will. Holy Spirit, keep me sensitive to Your correction as I move through this day. Slow me down when I begin to run ahead. Make me attentive when You are directing me another way. Give me discernment to recognize what is wrong for me even when it appears attractive and give me courage when the right path is difficult. I also pray for everyone who is building something today and feels uncertain about the next step. And I ask that You give them wisdom. For those whose plans have been shaken, steady their hearts and show them what remains worth building. For those beginning again after disappointment, give them courage to start with Christ at the center. For those experiencing success, keep them humble and dependent on You. 
Father, today I give You full authority over what I build. Leet my life be shaped by Your word, directed by Your wisdom, strengthened by Your grace and kept close to Jesus. When storms come, let me remain steady because my trust is in Christ. When blessings come, let me remain humble because every good thing comes from You. May everything You allow me to build honour You and remain useful for the purpose You intended. I place this day, my work, my family, my plans and my future into Your hands. Lead me, correct me and establish what comes from You. May Jesus Christ remain the foundation beneath it all.  
In Christ Jesus I pray. Amen
